one_line_contribution: A 2x2 provenance crossover in ALFWorld in which both containers — a distilled experience bank and a GEPA-optimized instruction — are built from the same training episodes but labelled by which three of the six task types those episodes came from, so that 'how much of memory's value an optimizer already holds' is read off the instruction-provenance x bank-provenance interaction at matched test type, with a best-of-w sampling ladder subtracted as a headroom correction.
closest_prior_work: EvoAgentBench (2607.05202), which the proposal itself concedes already puts ReasoningBank (+3.6) and GEPA (+1.2) on the same 528/267 trajectories and therefore already publishes the qualitative headline 'an optimizer given the same episodes gets roughly what the bank gets.' What survives is the provenance labelling, the combined optimizer-plus-bank cells and the ALFWorld setting — i.e., an identification-and-quantification contribution on top of a published qualitative result, which caps how much this can be worth. Second threat is MIPROv2 (2406.11695): instruction-only vs demonstration-only vs joint optimization on one training set is the two-container ablation, and its finding that the split is task-dependent pre-empts the answer's shape. Third, and under-acknowledged: ExpeL (2308.10144) already stores its learned artifact as a natural-language 'insights' block distilled from training episodes and prepended to the prompt. That artifact is an instruction in all but name, so the paper's rhetorical claim ('memory is just an un-optimized prompt') is arguably instantiated inside the closest target system rather than discovered by this study — the proposal's own Related Work concedes GEPA and ExpeL 'run the same learning principle.'
strongest_objection: The claim threshold is arithmetically incompatible with the design's own gate, so the primary can fail while the hypothesis is true. Delta_abs = [Inner(I_oth) - Inner(I_own)] - ladder correction is bounded above by Inner(I_oth), and the only guarantee the design provides on that quantity is G3: the relevance advantage at I0 is >= 4pt (lower CI >= 1pt). Inner(I_oth) will if anything be smaller than Inner(I0), since I_oth is more accurate than I0 and the proposal's own argument is that accuracy compresses Inner multiplicatively. So Delta_abs >= 5pt requires Inner(I_oth) > 5pt AND Inner(I_own) ~ 0 (essentially total absorption) AND a near-zero ladder correction, all at once. A study that passes G3 at 4-6pt and then finds a genuine 60-70% absorption produces Delta_abs ~ 2-3pt, below the stated MDE of 4.6-4.8pt, and is reported as inconclusive. The proposal never reconciles Prediction 2 (relevance advantage >= 4pt) with Prediction 1 (Delta_abs >= 5pt); as written they are close to mutually exclusive. Compounding this: (a) Ladder A is not information-free with respect to the quantity it corrects — committing to the modal admissible action over w samples mechanically attenuates the leverage of any injected text on the committed action, so Inner_H declines with w for prompt-sensitivity reasons rather than headroom, and Ladder B (step budget) shares no such mechanism, so agreement between the two ladders does not validate the fit and disagreement does not localize the fault. (b) The mechanism rule has no bucket for the most likely confound. B_oth is an active distractor (off-type procedures against a templated ALFWorld goal), so Inner is partly harm-driven, and a stronger on-type instruction is plausibly more robust to distracting text; that produces a break deficit under I_own, which the pre-registered 2/3 rule (fix deficit -> absorption, break excess -> interference) routes to 'mixed' rather than flagging as the alternative explanation it is. Distractor-robustness and content absorption are not separated anywhere in the Tier 0 grid.
what_would_fix_it: 1) Promote the scale-free absorbed share, 1 - Inner(I_own)/Inner(I_oth), from 'descriptive' to the confirmatory endpoint with a pre-registered threshold (e.g. >= 50% with a lower CI above 20%), and raise G3 from >= 4pt to >= 8-10pt so the ratio is estimable — a ratio endpoint is invariant to the size of the relevance advantage, which is exactly the unknown that currently decides whether the study can conclude anything. 2) Use the frontier reflector the track's resource section explicitly grants (a few hundred dollars for the optimizer/reflector role). A local 32B reflector is the choice that minimizes I1, minimizes absorption, and makes the G2 failure branch live; the proposal calls this conservative, but conservative here means designing for an effect below your own MDE. 3) Replace or supplement Ladder A with a level knob that does not change prompt sensitivity — e.g. an instruction optimized on a third, disjoint slice of episodes and titrated to matched accuracy, or off-type demonstration count — and add an explicit distractor-robustness control: a plausibly-worded, token-matched, task-irrelevant block run at BOTH I_own and I_oth. Cell 24 is the right object but it is Tier 1, single-instruction, and cuttable; promote it to Tier 0 and run it in both instruction cells. Add a break-deficit bucket to the mechanism rule. 4) Re-derive the compute arithmetic with the sampling and step multipliers: cell 10 is budgeted as 4,500 episodes x 15 calls = 67,500 calls, but best-of-w at w in {2,4,8} multiplies per-step calls, giving roughly 500 x 3 conditions x 15 steps x (2+4+8) = 315,000 calls — about a quarter of the entire stated 900,000-call Tier 0 budget from one cell, with the same error in cells 11 and 18. 5) Move I_all x {M0, B_all} on S_test into Tier 0 (see missing baseline).
missing_baseline: Two, both Tier 0 omissions. (i) I_all x {M0, B_all} on S_test — an instruction optimized on the whole pooled training set against the whole pooled bank, i.e. the configuration a practitioner actually deploys. Every square cell uses an instruction optimized on 500 games of three task types, so Prediction 5's headline practitioner number ('at an instruction optimized on the same episodes, the bank stops paying') is measured for a half-data, type-restricted optimizer run and is checked in the deployment configuration only at Tier 1 on the 274-game official splits (cell 20), which is cuttable and underpowered at n=274. (ii) A 2-shot expert-trajectory ReAct baseline as an alternative I0. The published ALFWorld results the proposal leans on for its '5-15 point' memory effects were obtained under scaffolds containing in-context expert trajectories; I0 here is a hand-written instruction with the demonstration slot empty. G1 (memory must gain >= 5pt at I0) becomes easier the weaker I0 is, and the paper's whole thesis is that the gain was an artifact of an unfilled instruction slot — which makes the choice of I0 the single most outcome-determining unmeasured design decision in the study. Without a demonstration-bearing I0, outcome (v) (the demonstration slot is the whole story) cannot be distinguished from absorption, and cell 16 (J) alone does not fix this because J is only run at the optimized instruction, not as an alternative baseline scaffold.
preprint_collision: The check is well above the norm and I credit it: dated scans (2026-09-03, prior 2026-08-21), 15 queries over 244 papers, 54 by-id abstract verifications, PDF-level verification of the closest work with a committed extracted-text SHA256, an explicit retraction/reinstatement log for five IDs wrongly dropped in v2, and a self-caught numerical correction (a web snippet's +7 for ReasoningBank corrected to +3.6 from the PDF). That is a real search, not a gesture. But it does not establish novelty, for three reasons the proposal itself states. First, arXiv is unreachable from the node and Semantic Scholar was rate-limited, so every 'confirmed absent' claim except the EvoAgentBench one rests on a single web-search channel; negative claims from a single channel are the weakest kind. Second, three pre-freeze obligations are undischarged and one of them — targeted search for held-out-episode and data-provenance crossovers in the prompt-optimization, contamination and data-attribution literatures — targets precisely the primitive the contribution rests on. The proposal is candid that if that search hits, the contribution reduces to the ALFWorld measurement, the on-policy control and the compiled-block comparison; a reviewer must score the proposal as submitted, and as submitted the core novelty claim is conditional on a search that has never been run. Third, obligation (1), the unopened appendix of 2608.14036, is the collision that would gut Prediction 6. I cannot name a preprint that already runs this exact provenance square — but my knowledge does not extend past most of the 2026 IDs cited, so I am relying on the proposal's own record, and by that record the strongest nearby result (EvoAgentBench's optimizer-vs-bank table on shared trajectories) is already published, which means even a clean scan leaves this as an identification-and-quantification paper rather than a new finding. Under the venue's own rule that an unsearched novelty claim is a weakness rather than a neutral, this costs the submission roughly a point of novelty even though the check itself is honest and unusually diligent.
